title: Plugin requirements declaration
description: Sidecar <plugin>/requirements.json contract consumed by env_check.py. Declares external CLI tools, local config files, and auth state a plugin needs to run -- never a target repo's toolchain. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-env-check-design.md, 'The declaration contract'.

requirements_version.description: Version of this schema the declaration was written against.

plugin.description: Must match the plugin's directory name (the parent of this file).

tools.description: External CLI tools the plugin's own skills/scripts invoke.

required.description: true = hard requirement, drives the exit code; false = optional, only degrades a capability.

why.description: Names the consuming skill(s). 'Missing gh' is a checklist; 'missing gh -- needed by backlog and create-issue' is actionable.

probe.description: argv array executed with shell=False. Never a shell string.

version_pattern.description: Regex with one capture group, applied to the probe's stdout to extract a version string.

min_version.description: Minimum acceptable version, compared against the value version_pattern extracts.

install.description: Exact install commands, keyed by platform, plus a docs pointer. --fix runs only the command for the detected platform verbatim; never composes one.

config.description: Local config files the plugin's skills read (e.g. the .local/ convention).

path.description: Path relative to the scope root.

scope.description: Whether path is relative to the target repo root or the user's home directory.

required.description: true = hard requirement; false = absence degrades a capability rather than breaking it.

remedy.description: What to run or do to produce this file.

auth.description: Authenticated CLI sessions the plugin's skills depend on.

name.description: The service or account being authenticated, for display.

probe.description: argv array executed with shell=False. Records exit status and a one-line summary only -- never token values.
